canonical_claim: For every smooth immersion f of the two-torus into Euclidean three-space, the Willmore energy, normalized as the surface integral of the square of the scalar mean curvature H = (k1 + k2) / 2, is at least 2*pi^2.

canonical_formal_target.blocker: The pinned library surface lacks an intake-verified scalar mean-curvature/Willmore-energy interface for smooth immersed compact surfaces; the exact source conventions and Lean encoding belong to the statement phase.

domain_and_universes: A smooth immersion of a smooth compact boundaryless surface diffeomorphic to the two-torus into Euclidean R^3; exact Lean types and universes are open.
quantifiers: Universal over the immersed torus (or an immersion f after a fixed torus model is selected).
conclusion: Willmore energy W(f) >= 2*pi^2 under the H=(k1+k2)/2 convention.
excluded_degenerate_cases: a sphere or arbitrary genus-zero surface
an abstract real-valued functional assumed to satisfy the desired inequality
